raw_text: Reviewer ready (member_002). Publish a fixed candidate when ready for independent review: use fix_patch, then handoff_patch to member_002 with the patch_id. For orientation, the issue targets ModelForm._post_clean / BaseModelForm behavior around `construct_instance` and `exclude` for fields absent from data, so `cleaned_data` values (or field defaults) can overwrite model field defaults. I will adopt your exact patch via integrate_patch, run the same-version public tests, and then org_review_patch. Please include your expected public test targets in the handoff message.

member_002 (independent reviewer) status + review contract.

BASELINE EVIDENCE I have actually produced (my own run, my own tree):
- Focused run `model_forms.tests` on the unmodified tree: 143 tests, 143 passed, 0 failed (validation_status=verified, seq 31). So the buggy baseline is currently GREEN => there is no regression test for this issue yet, and a "tests still pass" claim alone cannot demonstrate the fix.
- I removed a scratch repro file I had briefly added at repo root (v3 is clean, no net changes).

ROOT CAUSE I confirmed in django/forms/models.py `construct_instance`:
    if (f.has_default() and
            form[f.name].field.widget.value_omitted_from_data(form.data, form.files, form.add_prefix(f.name))):
        continue
This still skips a field that IS present in cleaned_data whenever the widget's value was omitted from the raw posted data — which is exactly the reported blocker (value derived in clean(), not in data payload). Secondary hazard: `form[f.name]` raises KeyError if the model field is not a form field at all.
Note `_post_clean` calls `construct_instance(self, self.instance, opts.fields, opts.exclude)` and separately builds `exclude = self._get_validation_exclusions()` for `full_clean`; those are two distinct lists, don't conflate them.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA I will apply to your exact published candidate:
C1) Model field with a default whose value is set in cleaned_data while absent from the data payload -> instance receives the cleaned_data value.
C2) No KeyError/crash when the field is absent from form.fields entirely but populated via cleaned_data.
C3) Preserved: field absent from cleaned_data still keeps the model default; checkbox and multiple-select "value omitted" semantics unchanged (unchecked checkbox still must NOT overwrite the default).
C4) A regression test is added to the public test suite that fails without the fix.
C5) I will integrate_patch your exact patch and run_tests on that exact version; focused model_forms + forms model tests must pass.
C6) Minimal diff, no unrelated behavior changes.

Please publish with fix_patch (task_ids=[]) and send me handoff_patch. I cannot accept until I have adopted your exact version and run tests on it. If you have already published, just send the patch id.
